final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: sink IREF (10 uA)
MNB  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1 m=2
* tail current source (10 uA)
M5   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1 m=2
* input differential pair (large area for low 1/f noise, high gm)
M1   n1    vinp  tail vss nfet W=60 L=1
M2   n2    vinn  tail vss nfet W=60 L=1
* PMOS mirror load (larger area, same W/L)
M3   n2    n2    vdd  vdd pfet W=8 L=1
M4   n1    n2    vdd  vdd pfet W=8 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink (40 uA)
M7   vout  n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=4 L=0.5 m=8
M8   vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1 m=8
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz   n1    nz    9k
Cc   nz    vout  0.8p
.ends
